reason: This branch changes components/explore/ExploreMapClient.tsx so the Explore map opens with all four provinces framed: the pan limit is widened to the framed view, and the minimum zoom drops to 1. The Sites version 43 observation (data/deployed-map-render-evidence-2026-09-27-v43.json) therefore no longer describes the client the Site would serve, and the gate correctly went stale. No preview measurement is possible: the ChatGPT Sites control plane exposes no preview URL for this project, and its only deployment operation publishes to production. OPERATIONS_HANDBOOK section 6.1 requires CI green on the exact commit being deployed, and this gate is what holds CI red, so the measurement that would clear it can only come from the deploy it blocks. This record bridges that gap and claims nothing else. Nothing was measured. The Site observation is owed and will be taken against the live Site immediately after the next production deploy, at which point this record is deleted and replaced by that observation.
